image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a wood rabbit (cottontail) situated in natural grassy vegetation. The rabbit is facing slightly right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has brown and grey fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears. A blade of grass obscures the very tip of its nose/mouth area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are clearly visible, upright, and show darker pigmentation at the tips consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large laterally positioned eyes providing wide field of view.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, dark, and positioned on the side of the head, matching leporid anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nose and mouth area are partially occluded by a blade of grass and the angle of the shot, making definitive verification of the split lip impossible.
